Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Price basis 2027 – part:370010, 1.4404 round bar dia 30 peeled
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation for part:370010 (1.4404 round bar, dia 30 mm, peeled).

We would like to continue with Blankstahl Werdenfels and are prepared to offer a meaningful commitment: the full 23,700 per year, fixed for 24 months from 1 January 2027. That gives you exactly the kind of stable, volume-based account your sales director has described as your focus.

However, we cannot accept €6.10. That is an increase of 4.5% on today's €5.84. Your own figures do not support it:
- AS-14404 at a 45% cost share and +5.9% accounts for roughly 2.7%.
- The PPI-C2431 movement largely reflects the same alloy and material inflation. Applying both on top of each other double-counts the material effect.
- Your delivery performance (OTD around 81% over the last four quarters) is also something we have to weigh against any increase.
- In each of the last three renewals we settled below the level initially asked.

We would also gladly take up your owner's offer to walk us through the calculation (material and hourly rates). If there is a cost element we are missing, we are happy to look at it on facts.

On that basis we propose the following packages. All three are equivalent for us, so please choose the one that suits you best:
1. €5.18 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24 months, no price adjustment clause
2. €5.14 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, no price adjustment clause
3. €5.09 per unit, payment 14 days net, 24 months, no price adjustment clause

All other terms as per your quotation (DAP, 14 days lead time, 23,700 per year, valid from 2027-01-01).

We look forward to your response.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl

move.subject: Re: Price basis 2027 – part:370010 (1.4404 round bar dia 30, peeled) – revised packages
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for moving towards our 24-month structure.

You asked for the data behind our delivery performance comment. These are the figures from our supplier scorecard for Blankstahl Werdenfels (rolling 12 months, our goods receipts):
- 2025Q4: OTD 82.7 %, OTD to confirmed date 85.2 %
- 2026Q1: OTD 83.8 %, OTD to confirmed date 86.2 %
- 2026Q2: OTD 82.5 %, OTD to confirmed date 85.0 %
- 2026Q3: OTD 81.0 %, OTD to confirmed date 83.5 %

For comparison, 2024Q3/Q4 were 86.5 % OTD and 90.5 to 93.2 % to the confirmed date, so delivery has trended down.

Your quality has clearly improved, to 32 ppm in the last 12 months, and we appreciate that. We are happy to go through the delivery figures with you in a call.

On price, €5.60 is still well above where we need to be:
- One year ago this part was quoted at €5.41, and today's price is €5.84.
- An AS-14404 clause also shifts the material risk fully to us. In that case the base price has to reflect that the material risk is no longer in your calculation.

We understand your concern about material volatility over 24 months. To meet it, we are now including an option with an AS-14404 clause, with a 5 % deadband and base month 2026-08.

We have moved our price up as well. The following three packages are equivalent for us; please choose the one that suits you best:
1. €5.30 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24 months, no price adjustment clause
2. €5.25 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24 months, AS-14404 clause (material share 45 %, deadband 5 %, base month 2026-08)
3. €5.21 per unit, payment 14 days net, 24 months, no price adjustment clause

All other terms remain as per your quotation: DAP, 14 days lead time, 23,700 per year, valid from 2027-01-01, 70 ppm.

With any of these packages you secure the full annual volume for two years, which is exactly the kind of volume account your sales director said you want to focus on. Our offer to review your calculation (material and hourly rates) together, as your owner suggested, still stands.

We look forward to your response.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – 1.4404 round bar – revised packages incl. your index clause structure
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your reply and for accepting a meeting on the delivery figures. We will propose dates separately so that this does not hold up the price agreement.

We have listened to your main point. You need an AS-14404 clause for a 24-month term, and you prefer it without a deadband. We now accept exactly that structure as one of our options: material share 45 %, base month 2026-08, 0 % deadband.

However, the base price has to reflect this. With a full index clause, the material risk sits entirely with us for the whole term. A base price of €5.60 combined with a full pass-through of material movements is not a fair split. €5.60 already sits close to your own September quotation for a fixed price, and one year ago this part was at €5.41 without any clause.

We have moved again, in a smaller step, and we are giving you the clause structure you asked for. The following three packages are equivalent for us; please choose the one that suits you best:

1. €5.39 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24 months, no price adjustment clause
2. €5.34 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24 months, AS-14404 clause (material share 45 %, deadband 5 %, base month 2026-08)
3. €5.22 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24 months, AS-14404 clause (material share 45 %, deadband 0 %, base month 2026-08), i.e. exactly your clause structure

All other terms remain as per your quotation: DAP, 14 days lead time, 23,700 per year for 24 months, valid from 2027-01-01, 70 ppm.

With any of these packages you secure our full annual volume for two years with a protected material position. We would very much like to conclude on this basis.

We look forward to your response.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
